summary: The executable dependency gate has a closed policy for seventeen assemblies and checks authored plus MSBuild-evaluated project/package/runtime/import boundaries. Pure layers reject outward adapter dependencies and App rejects executable/hosting behavior. The smaller CoreSolutionBoundary projection has unit-test callers and the solution-boundary document retains bootstrap-era coverage; neither replaces the current gate. Source-policy inspection establishes the intended boundary, while fresh MSBuild/import evaluation remains a distinct qualification step.
title: Use the enforced dependency graph rather than historical scaffold roster
